test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A – B means that A is the mother of B, A + B means that A is the father of B, A ÷ B means that A is the sister of B, then which of the following expression shows that P is the aunt of Q?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

**So,**

 
• Option - (1) : P + R ÷ Q → P is the father of R who is the sister of Q.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c1b895b50bc8931a4dcb76d897758eeadc1ae2f6f8026f019aafedbd554ddb5.png] 

Here, P is the father of Q.

 
• Option - (2) : P - R + Q → P is the sister of R who is the father of Q.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3300d44960cd5ccde5b8396945409b4b2661709d6cbe804e3e47267220495c64.png] 

Here, P is the grandmother of Q.

 
• Option - (3) : P ÷ R – Q → P is the sister of R who is the mother of Q.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c5e3aeceb63be867dfee6be68505974b2b7b123a59a4d1c108de6e1e774f4bb.png] 

**Here, P is the maternal aunt of Q.**

 
• Option - (4) : R ÷ P – Q → R is the sister of P who is the mother of Q.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ceaa2db3b6e4219372e9f27012ccf885abf4e3fe0af2b3ef4d07aba17b2bd205.png] 

Here, P is the mother of Q.

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.
